title: Unctuous Moroccan Pork Knuckle Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Moroccan dish featuring pork knuckle, perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in, this recipe is kid-friendly and flexitarian-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to medium-high heat.
Season the pork knuckle with cumin, coriander, and cinnamon.
Heat the olive oil in a large copper pot over medium heat.
Sear the pork knuckle until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine, chicken broth, and prunes to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the pork knuckle to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated grill, cooking for 2 hours or until the pork is tender.
Serve the pork knuckle with the rich and flavorful sauce spooned over the top.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
